Daily Devotional

December 21

31 The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness. (Proverbs 16:31 KJV)

The phrase “hoary head” is talking about gray hair, or old age.  If all Christians thought that gray hair was a crown of glory, they would quit trying to hide it by dying their hair.  This is saying that older people that are living in righteousness are like they have a crown of glory in the sight of God, and should be in the sight of man.  Older people, who are truly serving the Lord, have a special anointing on them that enables them to truly be an example to everyone else, especially the younger generations.  By the time a Christian gets gray hair, if he has been seeking the Lord all his life, then he has the qualities that allow him to represent God correctly.  Nothing is sadder than an old person who is lonely, depressed, and sad, because they have not felt that they have accomplished their goals in life.  Nothing is more rewarding than to see an old person, who is still happy, full of life, and looking forward to going to be with the Lord.  Serving God all your life is the only way to end your life in contentment.  Nothing compares to the peace and joy (Galatians 5:22-23) that only God can give you.

When you reach old age, and if you have been serving God for many years, you begin to realize what is important in life.  You become aware that things or possessions are not what are important, but what you do for others and how you lead your life are what matters.  It becomes real apparent that loving God first and foremost, and then loving others as yourself (Matthew 12:30-31) (just as Jesus taught) is all that really matters, not only in this world, but in our eternal life.  There is nothing more important than what we are in this life, rather than who we are.  If we can really become like Christ in this world, then we will have made a real difference in others, and know that we have lived the Christian life.  We may never reach this goal, but we need to try our best to obtain it by obeying Jesus (Hebrews 5:9).  The peace and joy that God gives us can not be compared to anything in this world.  Give yourself fully to the Lord, and know that in your old age you will feel content.  Thank you Lord for the fruit of the spirit, which you give to your children.  Praise God!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
